name: Velox Paceline Runner's Cargo Pant
description:
Featherlight technical pants in a four-way stretch microfiber, cut slim through the thigh and tapered at the ankle. Pale ash grey or deep navy. Seven pockets total — two hip, two thigh, two hidden interior waistband pockets, and one flat rear zippered compartment — all designed to sit flush against the body without bulk or bounce.

Built for couriers, parkour runners, and anyone who moves fast and needs their hands free. The fabric breathes well and dries in under an hour. Looks athletic but clean enough to walk into a mid-tier office without drawing stares.
functionality: Seven total pockets including two hidden waistband compartments, bounce-minimizing pocket design, quick-dry fabric
what_it_says: You move for a living and you've thought carefully about how to do it efficiently.
story_hooks: A runner discovers their 'hidden' waistband pocket was accessed and resealed mid-route — they never stopped moving.
The pants show up in a street market three tiers down from where they were manufactured, no tags, no origin data.
